title: Zara sa pani
body:
Zara sa pani
<<DIVIDER>>
Haaye
Hussain Jab Key Chaley Aye Baad-e-Dopahar Ran Ko
Na Tha Koi Key Jo Thaamey Rakab-e-Tousan Ko
Sakina Thaam Rahi Thee Abaa Key Daaman Ko
Hussain Chup Ke Khadey Hain
<<MINI>>
(Wa Ghurbata Wa Museebata) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hussain Chup Ke Khadey Hue Hain
<<MINI>>
Wa Ghurbata Wa Museebata
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain Chup Ke Khadey hui Hain
Nazar Alam Per Gadi Hui Hai
(Sakina Thaamey Abaa Ka Daaman) ..(2)
(Ye Apne Baba Se Keh Rahi Hay) ..(2)
Aye Pyare Baba Qasam Tumhari
<<MINI>>
Main Tishna Lab Hoon
Zara Sa Paani
(Wa Ghurbata Wa Museebata) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Chacha Se Aye Baba Jaan Keh Dein
Sakina Pyasi Hai Teen Din Se
(Zabaa'n Pe Kaa'nte Pade Hue Hain) ..(2)
(Key Mashk Khali Hai Teen Din Se) ..(2)
Lo Baba Dekho, Ye Mashk Khali
<<MINI>>
Main Tishna Lab Hoon
Zara Sa Paani
(Wa Ghurbata Wa Museebata) ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Mujhe Hai Ehsaas Mere Baba
Key Ham Se Pyase Ho Tum Ziyada
(Karungi Tum Se Na Phir Taqaza) ..(2)
(Hai Baba Beti Ka Tum Se Wada) ..(2)
Main Tum Pe Sadqey, Main Tum Pe Wari
<<MINI>>
Main Tishna Lab Hoon
Zara Sa Paani
(Wa Ghurbata Wa Museebata)..(3)
